title: Session recording
description: Render each session as a readable conversation under docs/sessions/ (transparency + continuity). Control with /recording.

hooks.name: session-recorder
hooks.why: Optional session recording. Replays the tail of the previous session so a developer returning is back in context. Inert unless .claude/session-recording.json is enabled. Control with /recording.

hooks.name: session-recorder
hooks.why: Optional session recording. Re-renders mid-turn, throttled. Inert unless enabled. Control with /recording.

hooks.name: session-recorder
hooks.why: Optional session recording. Re-renders after every assistant turn. Inert unless enabled. Control with /recording.

hooks.name: session-recorder
hooks.why: Optional session recording. Final render of the transcript. Inert unless enabled. Control with /recording.

gitignore: # --- Session transcripts (remove this line to commit them) ---
notes: Session recording enabled. Control it with /recording (status | on | off | pause | resume). Transcripts are gitignored by default.
